prompt: Create realistic sound effects for this short video. Scene: kitchen preparation with chopping and pan sizzle. Use natural ambience and match visible actions. Avoid speech, restaurant crowd, music, alarm beep, lyrics, voiceover.
claim_boundary: MMAudio output can be claimed as V2A only if WAV is actually generated from video input; T2A fallback is not video-synchronized evidence.

mmaudio_command_hint:
(
  set -e
  : "${MMAUDIO_ROOT:?set MMAUDIO_ROOT to your local MMAudio checkout}"
  mkdir -p '${MAINBASE:?set MAINBASE}/artifacts/model_runs/w18_dss_ablation/kitchen_chop_sizzle_001/naive'
  cd "$MMAUDIO_ROOT"
  BEFORE_FILE=$(find output -type f \( -name '*.flac' -o -name '*.wav' \) -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -n 1 | cut -d' ' -f2- || true)
  python demo.py --duration=10 --video='${MAINBASE:?set MAINBASE}/cases/kitchen_chop_sizzle_001/input_video.mp4' --prompt 'Create realistic sound effects for this short video. Scene: kitchen preparation with chopping and pan sizzle. Use natural ambience and match visible actions. Avoid speech, restaurant crowd, music, alarm beep, lyrics, voiceover.'
  AFTER_FILE=$(find output -type f \( -name '*.flac' -o -name '*.wav' \) -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -n 1 | cut -d' ' -f2- || true)
  if [ -z "$AFTER_FILE" ]; then echo "NO_MMAUDIO_OUTPUT_FOUND"; exit 2; fi
  if [ "$AFTER_FILE" = "$BEFORE_FILE" ]; then echo "MMAUDIO_OUTPUT_NOT_CHANGED"; exit 3; fi
  cp "$AFTER_FILE" '${MAINBASE:?set MAINBASE}/artifacts/model_runs/w18_dss_ablation/kitchen_chop_sizzle_001/naive/w18_011_kitchen_chop_sizzle_001_naive.flac'
  if command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null 2>&1; then ffmpeg -y -i '${MAINBASE:?set MAINBASE}/artifacts/model_runs/w18_dss_ablation/kitchen_chop_sizzle_001/naive/w18_011_kitchen_chop_sizzle_001_naive.flac' '${MAINBASE:?set MAINBASE}/artifacts/model_runs/w18_dss_ablation/kitchen_chop_sizzle_001/naive/w18_011_kitchen_chop_sizzle_001_naive.wav' >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
